previous_year_questions.question: Consider 3 processes P1, P2, P3 arriving at t=0 with burst times 10, 5, 8. Calculate average waiting time under Shortest Job First (SJF) non-preemptive.
previous_year_questions.explanation: Execution order P2 (5) -> P3 (8) -> P1 (10). Waiting times: P2=0, P3=5, P1=13. Avg = (0+5+13)/3 = 6.0ms.

exam_traps: In Preemptive SJF (SRTF), forgetting to recalculate remaining burst time every time a new process arrives.
In Round Robin, forgetting to append newly arriving processes to the ready queue BEFORE re-adding the preempted process.
quick_techniques: Gantt Chart Check: Sum of all interval lengths on the Gantt chart must equal total burst time of all processes.

linked_node_explanations.i-o-and-device-management: Configures I2C, SPI, and UART hardware peripherals and DMA buffers.
linked_node_explanations.threads-and-concurrency: Uses FreeRTOS tasks, queues, and semaphores for real-time task scheduling.
linked_node_explanations.os-process-memory: Requires strict memory bounds and low-level register bitwise operations.

milestones.title: Hardware Peripheral Drivers (I2C/UART)
milestones.description: Write non-blocking I2C sensor driver reading BME280 temperature and pressure values.

milestones.title: FreeRTOS Multitasking Architecture
milestones.description: Configure FreeRTOS kernel tasks, queues, and mutexes for sensor reading and logging.

milestones.title: Low-Power DMA & SPI Telemetry Transmission
milestones.description: Optimize DMA buffer transfers and transmit telemetry via SPI Wi-Fi module.
deliverables: Direct Memory Access (DMA) circular buffer config

projects.title: Vulkan 3D Physically Based Rendering (PBR) Engine
projects.description: Modern 3D graphics rendering engine built from scratch using Vulkan API in C++17. Features Physically Based Rendering (PBR) lighting equations, GLTF 3D model loading, shadow mapping, and dynamic Vulkan command buffer pipelines.
projects.architecture_overview: 3D Scene AST -> Vulkan Command Buffers -> PBR GLSL Shaders -> Vulkan Swapchain -> Display

linked_node_explanations.calculus-and-optimization-basics: Applies vector 3D linear algebra transformations and Cook-Torrance specular reflectance integrals.
linked_node_explanations.c-programming-and-memory-management: Manages Vulkan GPU memory allocations (VMA) and pointer offsets.
linked_node_explanations.data-visualization: Renders 3D mesh geometries, textures, and lighting shaders.

milestones.title: Vulkan Instance & Graphics Pipeline Setup
milestones.description: Initialize Vulkan instance, physical device selection, logical device creation, and swapchain.
deliverables: Graphics pipeline and GLSL shader compiler

milestones.title: GLTF 3D Model & Texture Loader
milestones.description: Parse GLTF 3D meshes and upload vertex buffers and texture samplers to GPU memory.
deliverables: Vulkan Memory Allocator (VMA) GPU staging buffers

milestones.title: Physically Based Rendering (PBR) & Shadow Maps
milestones.description: Implement Cook-Torrance PBR lighting GLSL shaders and depth shadow mapping.

projects.title: Zero-Trust Service Mesh Proxy Engine
projects.description: Zero-Trust service mesh sidecar proxy enforcing Mutual TLS (mTLS) encryption, SPIFFE/SPIRE cryptographic workload identity verification, and fine-grained Open Policy Agent (OPA) RBAC authorization across microservices.
projects.architecture_overview: Client Microservice -> Sidecar Proxy -> SPIRE Identity Check -> mTLS Handshake -> OPA AuthZ -> Service

linked_node_explanations.asymmetric-cryptography-and-pki: Generates short-lived X.509 SVID certificates for mTLS authentication.
linked_node_explanations.network-security-fundamentals: Enforces Zero-Trust microservice network access control policies.
linked_node_explanations.microservices-architecture: Functions as a transparent sidecar proxy handling service-to-service traffic.

milestones.title: SPIFFE/SPIRE Workload Attestation
milestones.description: Integrate SPIRE Workload API fetching short-lived X.509 SVID identity certificates.

milestones.title: Mutual TLS (mTLS) Sidecar Reverse Proxy
milestones.description: Build TCP reverse proxy requiring bidirectional mTLS client authentication.
deliverables: Dynamic SVID certificate key pair reloader

milestones.title: OPA Policy Enforcement & Telemetry Logger
milestones.description: Embed Open Policy Agent (OPA) engine evaluating Rego authorization policies.
deliverables: Fine-grained HTTP path and method RBAC rules
